Import offline planscanR records into the acquisition catalog.

Source: R/acquisition_catalog.R
acquisition_catalog_import_records.Rd

With records = NULL, the importer calls exported planscanR::index_cache() using the supplied cache root. No portal or cache writes occur. Legacy absolute file claims are converted below file_root and remain unverified; the catalog itself must live outside that root. Replaying an unchanged (import_source, import_row_id) is a no-op, while a changed payload is rejected.

Usage

acquisition_catalog_import_records(
  catalog,
  records = NULL,
  cache_dir = NULL,
  index_fn = planscanR::index_cache,
  import_source = "planscanR-index-v1",
  file_root = NULL,
  file_root_id = "legacy-root"
)

Arguments

catalog

A catalog from acquisition_catalog_open().

records

A data frame from planscanR::index_cache(), or NULL to call index_fn.

cache_dir

Optional cache root passed to index_fn.

index_fn

Exported planscanR-compatible index function.

import_source

Stable source namespace for the import ledger.

file_root

Optional legacy file root used to make paths portable.

file_root_id

Stable identifier for file_root.

Value

A list of counts (imported, replayed, sources, documents, files) and imported reference IDs.
